benign.title: Tilt after big losses
benign.text: One player enters +79% more pots right after a big loss (more than 100% of pairs). Reckless play while tilting can look like chip dumping.

benign.title: A hyper-aggressive player
benign.text: One player bets and raises 9.9x as often as they call (more than 98% of pairs). Folding to an aggressive player is normal; the question is whether the folds are specific to the partner.

benign.title: Seated side by side
benign.text: They sat next to each other in 86% of shared hands (more than 97% of pairs). Position alone creates more steals and folds between neighbours.
